project.name: Ampfield Energy
project.brief: Ampfield Energy, a fictional company, designs, builds, finances and runs rooftop solar, battery storage and fleet charging on industrial and commercial property in Sweden, Denmark, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom. The site is read by operations, property and finance managers, and it speaks as the engineers who build the systems do: plain British English, figures over adjectives, and no hype.
